DCAppAttestService.doc: A service that you use to validate the instance of your app running on a device.

DCDevice.doc: A representation of a device that provides a unique, authenticated token.

-attestKey:clientDataHash:completionHand.doc: Asks Apple to attest to the validity of a generated cryptographic key.

-generateAssertion:clientDataHash:comple.doc: Creates a block of data that demonstrates the legitimacy of an instance of your app running on a device.

-generateKeyWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Creates a new cryptographic key for use with the App Attest service.

-generateTokenWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Generates a token that identifies the current device.

sharedService.doc: The shared App Attest service that you use to validate your app.

supported.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether a particular device provides the App Attest service.

currentDevice.doc: A representation of the device for which you want to query the two bits of data.

supported.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device supports the DeviceCheck API.
